Class TechRequestService

java.lang.Object
services.BaseService<TechRequest>
services.GenericService<TechRequest>
services.TechRequestService
public class TechRequestService extends GenericService<TechRequest>
TechRequestService is a concrete service. It implements logic for IT support tickets: listing by employee or specialist, stable ordering for the UI, and reassigning work when a tech specialist account is removed.
